title: Edge forwarder: per-tenant sampling hooks and soft-quota enforcement for VPC/on-prem
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement per-tenant sampling hooks and a soft-quota enforcement layer in the edge forwarder used by Dedicated and Private deployments (VPC and on-prem). This ticket covers: (1) adding a lightweight sampling hook API so downstream services can register tenant-aware sampling strategies and override global defaults; (2) introducing a soft-quota mechanism in the forwarder that enforces configurable token budgets per tenant with graceful degradation (probabilistic drop + bundle reporting) rather than hard rejection; and (3) telemetry and dashboards to surface quota health and sampling effects (latency/error correlations, ingest reduction). The goal is to reduce tail-cost for high-volume tenants, decrease noisy tenant impact on shared perimeters, and provide operators visibility and control without breaking strict SLOs for higher-tier customers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Edge forwarder exposes a documented sampling hook interface that can be enabled per-deployment and per-tenant. 2) Soft-quota enforcement enforces per-tenant token budgets with configurable window and bleed behavior; default policy is non-disruptive and logs dropped-sample counts. 3) End-to-end tests demonstrating: a) high-volume tenant is shaped to quota and downstream services observe reduced ingest; b) tiered tenants retain SLOs under noisy neighbor load. 4) Console dashboards added: quota utilization heatmap, per-tenant dropped-samples timeline, and sampling impact dashboard showing latency and error delta pre/post shaping. 5) Backwards compatibility maintained for existing collectors; rollout plan documented (canary steps + rollback).
tasks: Design sampling hook API and register lifecycle (Aisha, 2d)
Implement hook skeleton in forwarder with pluggable strategies (Marco, 4d)
Build soft-quota controller: windowing, probabilistic drop, token refill (Marco, 3d)
Add structured metric emitters for quota events and sampling decisions (SRE, 2d)
Create automated integration tests simulating noisy tenants and validating bleed behavior (QA, 3d)
Dashboard: add ETA/queries for quota heatmap and dropped-samples (Observability PM, 2d)
Run canary in staging dedicated cluster, monitor for regressions (Operations, 2d)
Prepare rollout doc and runbook with rollback steps (Support, 1d)
technical_notes:
- Sampling hook API: minimal interface {tenant_id, trace_metadata, policy_hint} -> decision {keep|drop|sample_rate_override}. Keep decision path must be O(1). Avoid heavy calls in hot path; use async cached policy lookups with TTL.
- Soft-quota: use leaky-bucket per-tenant with token window measured in tokens-per-minute. Implement probabilistic dropping at excess rate to avoid synchronized spikes. Emit metrics: quota_tokens, tokens_used, drops_by_reason, sample_decisions_count.
- Perf: forwarder hot-path must remain within current p50/p95 CPU budget. Aim for <3% added p95 latency in synthetic microbenchmarks.
- Data retention: ensure dropped samples are recorded at aggregated telemetry; do not persist raw spans for dropped traces.
- Compatibility: default policy when feature flag off is no-op. Provide feature-flag gating per-deployment and per-tenant via config map.
decisions: 1) Use leaky-bucket + probabilistic drop instead of hard rejection to preserve partial visibility for debugging. 2) Sampling hooks will be synchronous-but-fast with TTL-backed policy cache; remote policy fetch only on cache miss. 3) Emit standardized tags on dropped traces (quota.reason=soft_quota) to allow easy filtering in dashboards and downstream analysis.
